input.goal: Rinse the chickpeas, then place the chickpeas on a towel and lightly towel dry them so they aren't wet from rinsing. You can remove any loose skins at this time too.

sub_goals.text: Drain the chickpeas and rinse the can.
Rinse and drain the chickpeas in the colander.
Transfer the chickpeas to paper towels and dry them.
Remove loose skins from the chickpeas.
Transfer the chickpeas to a baking tray and continue removing loose skins.

l3_relation_types.temporal_order: which of two events (from different sub-goals) happened first in the activity; the Solver sees the two segments in a SHUFFLED order and must infer the order from state cues (flour already on the ball, pan already full)
l3_relation_types.object_continuity: the same object / ingredient appears in both events; what happened to it between them (chopped broccoli -> in the pan)
l3_relation_types.state_change: how the state of an object differs between the two events (whole -> chopped, empty -> full, raw -> browned)
l3_relation_types.causal_prerequisite: the earlier event is a physical prerequisite of the later one (could not be done without it)
l3_relation_types.hidden_state: an appliance / container state was set in the earlier event and is not visible in the later segment; what is its state at the end of the later segment
l3_relation_types.spatial_end_state: after placements in the two events, which listed object ends nearest / farthest to a reference object (needs 3D records)

plan.goal: Rinse the chickpeas, then place the chickpeas on a towel and lightly towel dry them so they aren't wet from rinsing. You can remove any loose skins at this time too.

events.description: The person opens the can of chickpeas.
events.relevance: The can must be opened to access the chickpeas.

events.description: A metallic popping or cracking sound is heard as the can is opened.
events.relevance: Indicates the successful opening of the can.

events.description: The liquid is poured out of the can into the sink.
events.relevance: Removes the canning liquid from the chickpeas.

events.description: Water is run into the empty can to rinse it.
events.relevance: Cleans the can for recycling or disposal.

events.description: Water is heard running and splashing into the can.
The chickpeas are poured from the can into a colander.
events.relevance: Transfers the chickpeas to a vessel suitable for rinsing.

events.description: Water is run over the chickpeas in the colander to rinse them.
events.relevance: Washes away the remaining canning liquid.

events.description: The colander is shaken to drain the excess water.
events.relevance: Removes the bulk of the rinsing water before drying.

events.description: The chickpeas are transferred from the colander onto paper towels.
events.relevance: Places the chickpeas on an absorbent surface for drying.

events.description: The chickpeas are patted and rubbed with paper towels to dry them.
events.relevance: Removes the remaining moisture from the chickpeas.

events.description: Loose skins are picked off the chickpeas using fingers.
events.relevance: Improves the texture of the chickpeas for the final dish.
Clears the unwanted skins from the workspace.

events.description: The chickpeas are moved from the paper towels to a baking tray.
events.relevance: Prepares the chickpeas for roasting or further processing.

events.description: More loose skins are picked off the chickpeas on the baking tray.
events.relevance: Ensures all loose skins are removed before the next cooking step.

relations.ask: Why did the person open the can?
relations.answer_hint: The can must be opened before the chickpeas can be poured into the colander.

relations.ask: What happened to the chickpeas after they were poured into the colander?
relations.answer_hint: They were rinsed and then transferred to paper towels.

relations.ask: How did the state of the chickpeas change between being in the colander and on the paper towels?
relations.answer_hint: They went from being wet from rinsing to being dried with paper towels.

relations.ask: Where were the chickpeas moved to after being on the paper towels?
relations.answer_hint: They were transferred to a baking tray.

relations.ask: Which happened first: draining the liquid from the can or pouring the chickpeas into the colander?
relations.answer_hint: The liquid was drained from the can before the chickpeas were poured out.

decision_points.why: The person must decide to drain the liquid and rinse the can before dealing with the chickpeas.
The person must decide to pour the chickpeas into the colander and rinse them.
The person must decide to transfer the chickpeas to paper towels to dry them.
The person must decide to start removing the loose skins from the chickpeas.
The person must decide to transfer the chickpeas to a baking tray to continue the process.
The person must decide that enough skins have been removed and the task is complete.
